JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

IFM Retail Director

This role offers full remote flexibility with strategic travel up to 30%, with a strong preference for candidates based in the Midwest region.

Lead the transformation of North America's largest retail facilities portfolio as our IFM Retail Director, where you'll command operational excellence across 10+ million square feet spanning 1,800+ dynamic retail environments. This remote leadership role offers the unique opportunity to shape the future of integrated facilities management while building and inspiring a geographically diverse team of facilities and engineering professionals who deliver mission-critical services to one of the industry's most prestigious retail clients.

Step into a role where your strategic vision directly impacts thousands of retail locations across North America, driving service innovation and operational efficiency at unprecedented scale. You'll collaborate with executive stakeholders, lead transformative client initiatives, and leverage your deep expertise in dynamic contracts and facilities outsourcing to deliver measurable business results. This is your chance to elevate your career while leading a world-class team in an environment that rewards excellence, innovation, and leadership impact.

Here is some of what your day will look like:

  • Oversee service delivery for the entire retail portfolio, ensuring all facilities services meet contract requirements, performance standards, and client expectations
  • Lead and develop management-level staff across geographically dispersed teams, providing coaching, performance management, and succession planning while fostering teamwork and excellence
  • Manage vendor relationships and performance to ensure third-party services are delivered according to contract terms and quality standards
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives including cost savings programs, benchmarking, best practices implementation, and innovation leveraging JLL's platform and regional networks
  • Ensure KPI and SLA achievement across all account metrics while maintaining strict adherence to governance processes and compliance requirements
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through superior support, regular communication, and exceptional service quality as measured by client feedback and satisfaction scores
  • Manage financial operations including annual budgeting, monthly budget performance reporting, invoice approvals, contract negotiations, and third-party spend oversight
  • Champion workplace excellence by advocating for diversity and inclusion, maintaining safety standards, and upholding JLL's core values of Teamwork, Ethics, and Excellence

Here is who we are looking for:

  • A bachelor degree or higher
  • 10+ years of experience specifically managing retail facilities, with proven managerial experience required as this role will manage a team of Senior Managers
  • Strong client relationship management, strategic thinking with execution capabilities, independent leadership with excellent organizational and multitasking skills, outstanding communication and presentation abilities, and a forward-thinking mindset that drives innovation and transformation
  • Strong retail banking or similar geographically distributed small site portfolio experience, capable of managing high-touch, brand focused, and specialty spaces

raw.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With more than 22,000 employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone anywhere.

We work with focus agility and shared purpose moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking experienced leaders who are motivated by accountability ownership and measurable impact.

About the Role

*This role requires demonstrated success in leading complex global clinical studies through all phases of execution, from study start-up to close-out.

As a Global Clinical Operations Leader/ Clinical Trial Manager, you will lead the clinical operations strategy and execution of global clinical trials. This role has direct accountability for delivering studies on time within budget and to the highest quality standards while ensuring patient safety and regulatory compliance.

You will serve as the primary clinical liaison to project leadership and sponsor teams coordinating cross functional contributors across regions and time zones. This is a highly visible leadership role suited for individuals who thrive in complex global environments and are comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situations. Success requires strong ownership, the ability to lead without close supervision and a history of delivering clinical trials within a CRO environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead global clinical operations strategy and execution for assigned clinical trials.
  • Drive study startup including site selection, monitoring strategy, and operational planning.
  • Coordinate cross functional teams across geographies ensuring alignment on timelines quality and deliverables.
  • Monitor study progress including recruitment retention data quality and timelines and take corrective action when needed.
  • Identify risks early and implement mitigation and contingency plans.
  • Provide leadership direction and performance feedback to project team members.
  • Function as primary point of contact for sponsors on clinical operations topics.
  • Ensure compliance with ICH GCP regulatory requirements and internal processes.
  • Oversee maintenance and quality of study documentation and central files.
  • Support audits inspections and study closeout activities including database lock and archiving.
  • Provide strategic oversight of the integrated data delivery (IDD) framework and champion a proactive data-quality culture

You will thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strong leadership decision making and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated ability to lead global teams across cultures and time zones
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands and remain accountable for outcomes
  • A proactive mindset with strong ownership and sense of urgency
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced performance driven environment

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in life sciences, nursing, or equivalent clinical research experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading clinical operations within a CRO environment
  • Proven experience in roles such as Clinical Trial Manager, Clinical Project Manager or Clinical Operations Leader
  • Experience leading complex global or multi-region studies
  • Strong knowledge of ICH GCP regulatory requirements and clinical trial processes
  • Experience coordinating cross functional teams and managing study timelines budgets and quality
  • Proficiency with clinical systems and standard tools such as CTMS, EDC, and eTMF

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior monitoring experience or strong site engagement background
  • Experience contributing to process improvements or operational excellence initiatives
  • Familiarity with multiple therapeutic areas or late phase studies with priority given to those with Metabolic, Obesity, MASH, Ophthalmology and Dermatology / Immunology

The potential base pay range for this role is competitive and aligned to experience level location and demonstrated expertise. Additional incentives may be available based on performance and role scope.

This role is designed for experienced clinical leaders who are ready to take full ownership of global trial delivery. If you are looking for a position with clear accountability, high expectations and meaningful impact on patient outcomes this is the right opportunity.

EEO Disclaimer
Parexel is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected status, which in the US includes race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of engineering and client success — embedded directly with customers to implement, customize, and scale the product in their environment. Deployment & Integration

  • Translate ambiguous client requirements into a scoped technical plan and execute it independently

Client-Facing Technical Ownership

  • Run technical discovery calls and debug issues live with client stakeholders
  • Communicate solutions in terms non-technical audiences can act on
  • Identify recurring friction points across clients and feed them back to product and engineering as structured input

Iteration & Scale

  • Monitor deployed solutions for reliability and performance, fixing or flagging issues before the client notices
  • Document deployment patterns and reusable components so future rollouts move faster
  • Balance delivery speed against long-term durability of deployed solutions

Must-Have

  • Full-stack or backend proficiency with hands-on production code experience — reading and writing code, not configuration-only work
  • Demonstrated experience building custom integrations, scripts, or internal tooling to connect a core product with external client systems
  • Track record of owning technical implementations end-to-end: scoping, building, shipping, and supporting

  • C1+ English (CEFR) — primary technical contact for US-based client accounts

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with API integrations, webhooks, and common auth patterns (OAuth, SSO)

  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL, or scripting (Python preferred)

  • Direct Mentorship: Guidance from international industry experts
  • Learning & Development: Ongoing access to resources for professional growth
  • Global Networking: Connect with professionals worldwide

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Application
  2. Screening
  3. Skills Assessment
  4. Topgrading Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Job Offer
  7. Client Onboarding

Ready to Join Us?

If you’re empathetic, organized, and passionate about improving patient experiences through operational excellence, this role is for you. Apply now to help make specialized healthcare more accessible to patients across the U.S.

Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer to join the Tendem project (**) andcreate high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, layout design, and branding to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, your focus will be on layouts, infographics, social media templates, and overall visual polish. We need a versatile, all-around graphic designer to handle diverse visual tasks, utilizing industry-standard tools to structure information cleanly and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the creation of clean layouts, modern infographics, and establish a clear visual hierarchy to ensure readable and engaging content.
  • Design highly engaging, reusable templates for various social media channels, as well as impactful one-pagers.
  • Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
  • Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.

Job Description:


We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role:

Wiley’s prestigious social science and humanities (SSH) portfolio is looking for a dynamic and ambitious individual to join the team in the role of Editor-in-Chief, Education. You will use your background in educational research, your knowledge of the publishing landscape, and your strong communication and global networking skills to drive the strategic development of one or more journals, raising the profile and visibility of those journal(s) in the community, and attracting new authors and content. The Editor-in-Chief will also be involved in the peer review process and decision-making of submitted manuscripts and ensuring adoption of best practices and highest ethical standards in publishing.

How you will make an impact

  • Leverage your international networks and knowledge of educational research, with desk research skills, to drive high-quality submissions in key subject areas to the Education portfolio.
  • Strategically develop one or more journals, from scientific and publishing perspectives within the context of the broader Education portfolio.
  • Establish and maintain a strong global network of researchers and practitioners who are the journals’ authors, peer reviewers and board members.
  • Represent Wiley and the Education portfolio at conferences and through in-person and virtual outreach activities at universities and research institutes.
  • Oversee the editorial evaluation, peer review, and decision making for submitted manuscripts.
  • Collaborate with your manager and colleagues to establish a team culture of trust, respect and high performance.

What we look for:

  • A PhD degree in educational research, with an excellent research background and a strong understanding of recent trends and developments in a variety of educational contexts.
  • Manuscript handling experience (including pre-screening, peer review, final decision, appeals and integrity cases).
  • Demonstrated commissioning experience including identifying priority topics, approaching prospective authors, agreeing outlines/timelines, and guiding authors through to submission.
  • Strong global networks within research communities.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative setting and achieve results through personal influence and engagement.
  • Flexible and innovative approach to problems and a focus on defining and achieving outcomes.
  • Outstanding organizational and time management skills with an excellent command of the English language (both written and verbal).
  • A strong understanding of scientific publishing, and desire to advocate for innovations in publishing and open research.
  • Confidence to present and represent the Education portfolio at international conferences/ institute visits, nurture existing contacts and develop new networks

We power infinite possibilities.


For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.

Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact for assistance.

We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. Our values support courageous teammates, needle movers, and learning champions all while striving to support the health and well-being of all employees. We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. 40,200 GBP to 57,533 GBP

  • Implement the products based on best Practices.
  • Review the current architectural landscape and make appropriate recommendations.
  • Must be able to compare various solutions and determine the one which best fits the need.
  • Research new technologies and products for their applicability to business processes.

Educational Qualifications:
  • A Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university with a major in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or other related scientific or technical discipline is required.
  • A Master’s Degree is preferred.
Required Skills:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in IT or Computer Science and 10+ years of IT work experience or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred.
  • At least six (6) years of experience working with the design and implementation of systems and applications in Amazon Web Services (AWS) environment.
  • 5+ years of experience working in federal contracting, providing IT services to multiple agencies
  • Must have a minimum of 5+ years of experience in RFP solutioning and knowledge of Federal agencies such as CMS, ED, VA, IRS, and HHS.
  • Knowledge of government business domain and/or strong commercial solution implementation is required.
  • Hands-on experience in solution, technical or information architecture required.
  • The ideal candidate should come from a solutions delivery/program delivery background
  • Knowledge of industry proposal practices, including Shipley Best Practices
  • Excellent communication skills with a high level of proficiency in business and technical writing, editing, and proofreading
  • Sets up administrator and service accounts and troubleshoot creates/updates and Maintains system documentation, interacts with users, and evaluates vendor products, deep understanding of monitoring AWS instances and services
  • Amazon Web Services (AWS) platform capabilities and best practices architectures, and engineering solutions within multiple Cloud accounts and services.
  • Experience working in AWS via the CLI and management console. Knowledge and experience architecting and configuring Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs).
  • Understanding of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Well Architected Framework.
  • Proven technical knowledge of networks, internet systems, databases, and operating systems including Linux, and Microsoft in AWS.
  • Must be detail-oriented, have strong problem-solving skills, and be able to understand technical requirements quickly.
  • Demonstrating good interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

Standard Employee Benefits.
50% Health Insurance Paid by Innosoft, Paid Vacation, 401K Match, STD LTD and AD&D paid by Innosoft.

The Senior Data Systems Analyst leads the integration of various healthcare payer data and internal enterprise systems data into WellBe’s enterprise data platforms. This role is responsible for analyzing, mapping, validating, and standardizing various payer feeds including eligibility, claims, quality, and risk adjustment data, alongside internal systems such as EMR , CRM, HR etc to maintain a reliable single source of truth supporting value based care.

The ideal candidate will combine strong healthcare data knowledge, technical domain expertise with ownership over complex payer and internal systems integration and manage multiple concurrent data initiatives and integration.

  • Lead onboarding and integration of various payer feeds, including eligibility (834 or flat files), medical and institutional claims (837 or flatfiles), HEDIS quality data, HIE, and risk adjustment and RAF related datasets
  • Analyze and map data from external payer sources and internal systems such as EMR, CRM, and operational platforms into the enterprise data model
  • Own and maintain source to target mappings, transformation logic, and standardized data definitions across payer and internal feeds
  • Identify payer specific variations, data quality issues, and structural differences, and drive normalization within the data warehouse
  • Validate data ingestion and transformations through profiling, reconciliation, and exception analysis

In this role, you'll use your bot engineering expertise, conversational design skills, and quality-focused approach to build reliable, useful bots and messaging integrations that deliver a great user experience. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor bot implementations to improve correctness, reliability, maintainability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and build stable, user-friendly bot experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $35 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

You will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping pricing and monetization strategy across cloud-based, AI-enabled, and digital product portfolios. Operating at a consulting level, this role applies broad technical and business expertise to develop scalable monetization frameworks, guide complex pricing decisions, and influence cross-functional strategy. You will lead advanced analytics, financial modeling, and strategic recommendations that inform executive decision-making and support value-driven growth.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of complex pricing strategies for cloud, AI, and platform-based products, including consumption, subscription, tiered, token-based, and hybrid models.
    - Design and evolve monetization frameworks that align pricing architecture to usage, value realization, customer outcomes, and long-term business strategy.
    - Identify, evaluate, and guide new revenue opportunities tied to AI-enabled capabilities, data services, APIs, cloud ecosystems, and partner-driven models.
    - Serve as a recognized subject-matter expert in cloud and AI monetization, advising stakeholders on best practices, tradeoffs, risks, and scalable commercialization approaches.
    - Build, own, and refine complex pricing and business models for consumption-based, subscription, platform, and outcome-based offerings.
    - Evaluate unit economics, including customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, margin profile, usage behavior, and scalability of cloud-native and AI-enabled offerings.
    - Apply advanced analytics, market benchmarks, and scenario modeling to guide pricing decisions, investment tradeoffs, and future product monetization opportunities.
    - Partner with product, engineering, finance, sales, marketing, and go-to-market leaders to align pricing strategy with product architecture, customer value, and delivery models.
    - Translate complex technical capabilities, including AI models, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data services, and marketplace integrations, into commercially viable monetization constructs.
    - Influence roadmap decisions, investment priorities, and governance discussions through data-driven insights, market intelligence, and executive-ready recommendations.
    - Deliver executive-ready insights, business cases, and strategic recommendations that clearly connect pricing decisions to financial impact, customer value, and growth objectives.
    - Present monetization strategies, financial scenarios, and decision points for cloud and AI offerings to senior leadership and governance forums.

    - Advanced proficiency with financial modeling, SQL, Python, BI tools, and analytics methods used to evaluate pricing performance, unit economics, and market opportunities.
    - Strong executive communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions across senior technical, financial, and commercial audiences.

Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Alteryx is searching for a DevOps Platform Engineer. This position is remote-friendly.

Position Overview:

As a DevOps Platform Engineer within Data Platforms, you will strengthen the standards, automation, and operational practices that enable reliable data product delivery across our enterprise data ecosystem. This role focuses on how data products are developed, tested, reviewed, deployed, monitored, and supported across dbt, Snowflake, GitLab, and related platforms.

You will partner with technical data leads to implement and maintain engineering standards that enable centralized Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and federated Data Ops business teams to deliver trusted production data products consistently and efficiently within our data mesh model.

Success in this role means improving engineering consistency, reducing operational friction, increasing release confidence, and helping teams deliver trusted, maintainable data products at scale.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain reusable engineering patterns, standards, templates, and guardrails for data product delivery across dbt, Snowflake, GitLab, and related platforms.

  • Maintain code quality practices, including linting, formatting, naming conventions, merge request templates, and review expectations.

European Field Service Technical Director

Europe | Pan-European scope | Significant travel across Europe

Location: Europe, home-based with access to a major European travel hub.
Travel: Significant European travel, particularly during the initial transformation phase ~ 50-80%.
Working language: English.

The opportunity

Diversey, a Solenis company, is seeking an established European Field Service leader to transform and strengthen our Technical Service organisation across Europe.

This is a senior pan-European mandate with functional leadership across a large network of several hundred technicians and technical service employees. Working through Country Technical Service Directors and Managers, you will create a more consistent European operating model, strengthen leadership and governance, and improve safety, service quality, customer uptime and operational performance.

Our technicians and service partners install, connect, maintain and repair physical equipment at customer sites. Their work is critical to the safe and uninterrupted operation of our customers’ businesses.

This is an operational line-leadership role rather than a project-only transformation position. Dedicated project resources will support delivery, but you will lead the organisation, define the operating model and embed new ways of working across countries.

What you will do

Lead the European Field Service organisation

  • Provide functional leadership across a large, geographically dispersed European technician and technical-service population.
  • Lead and influence Country Technical Service Directors and Managers within a complex matrix organisation.
  • Establish clear European priorities, standards and accountability while recognising legitimate local requirements.
  • Build a connected leadership community focused on collaboration, capability development and consistent execution.

Transform the operating model

  • Define and implement a practical European Field Service operating model.
  • Harmonise planning, scheduling, dispatch, prioritisation, utilisation and emergency-response practices.
  • Strengthen work-order management, service documentation, performance visibility and consistent use of enterprise systems.
  • Standardise critical processes and governance while ensuring that change is adopted and sustained locally.
  • Translate strategy into practical actions, clear ownership and measurable operational improvement.

Improve service performance

  • Establish meaningful European Field Service KPIs and management routines.
  • Improve safety, service quality, response time, customer uptime, first-time fix, productivity, cost-to-serve and customer satisfaction.
  • Strengthen resource and capacity planning across countries.
  • Create transparent reporting, escalation and corrective-action processes.

Stay connected to customers and technicians

  • Spend time at customer sites with technicians and country service teams.
  • Ensure that European processes work in practice for installations, preventive and corrective maintenance, breakdown response and technical interventions.
  • Use direct operational insight to remove barriers, improve working practices and build credibility with the Field Service community.

Lead internal and external service capacity

  • Align internal technicians and third-party technical service providers within one European model.
  • Strengthen partner selection, qualification, onboarding, training and performance management.
  • Establish consistent governance covering safety, technical capability, quality, service levels, cost and escalation.
  • Develop external service capacity where additional geographic coverage or specialist capability is required.

What you will bring

  • Significant senior leadership experience in Field Service, Technical Service, After-Sales, Customer Engineering or a closely comparable technical service organisation.
  • Proven responsibility across multiple European countries or another complex international region.
  • Experience leading managers and a substantial, geographically dispersed population of technicians or service engineers.
  • Direct leadership experience in a customer-site environment involving the installation, maintenance and repair of physical equipment.
  • Strong understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance, technical troubleshooting, service response, safety and customer-site delivery.
  • Credibility with technicians and Field Service leaders, developed through direct technical or operational experience and regular exposure to customer-site operations.
  • Evidence of personally transforming how a Field Service or Technical Service organisation operates through line leadership.
  • Experience standardising processes, strengthening governance, implementing KPIs and embedding systems and new ways of working.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior country leaders and deliver change through a matrix.
  • Experience governing contractors, authorised service organisations, distributors or technical service partners.
  • A strong service culture and an understanding of how responsiveness, uptime, safety, quality and cost-to-serve affect customer operations and business performance.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Europe.

Additional experience that would be advantageous

  • Experience in hygiene, dosing systems, warewashing, commercial laundry, foodservice equipment or another comparable customer-site service environment.
  • Experience in lifts and elevators, industrial machinery, automation, HVAC, building systems, medical or laboratory equipment, water treatment, packaging or similar installed-equipment sectors.
  • Experience leading both direct technical teams and outsourced service networks.
  • P&L, service-budget or cost-management responsibility.
  • Experience implementing Field Service Management, CRM, ERP, work-order or workforce-planning systems.
  • Professional capability in another European language.

Is this the right opportunity for you?

  • This role requires an established European Field Service leader who has already led managers, sizeable technical populations and meaningful operational change.
  • Experience centred primarily on Customer Service, sales, PMO or transformation programmes, software support, product engineering, helpdesks or internal plant maintenance will not be sufficient unless it is accompanied by directly comparable customer-site Field Service leadership at scale.
  • You will be comfortable moving between strategy and operations: setting a European direction, influencing country leaders, visiting customer sites and ensuring that change works for the technicians and customers it affects.

Why join us?

  • A high-impact European mandate with visible sponsorship and genuine transformation scope.
  • The opportunity to shape how a major technical service population works across countries, internal teams and external partners.
  • Direct influence on customer uptime, safety, service quality, operational performance and retention.
  • A dynamic international environment within a global organisation committed to sustainability, innovation and customer value.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Role Overview

Sr. Market Research Analyst will serve as a strategic analytical partner supporting McKesson's relationships with mature, well-known pharmaceutical manufacturers. This role bridges market intelligence, clinical insights, and financial modeling to optimize McKesson's distribution strategy for established manufacturers with multiple products in market. The position requires deep understanding of pharmaceutical market dynamics, clinical product profiles, and channel economics to guide critical business decisions across BSMR's brand and specialty distribution networks. This leader will provide essential inputs for complex financial models, evaluate product pipelines, and serve as an internal consultant on channel strategy while maintaining strong cross-functional partnerships with finance, product management, and distribution teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Economic & Clinical Modeling Partnership - Collaborate closely with Financial Modeling teams to provide market intelligence, clinical insights, and strategic assumptions for complex manufacturer models. Manage analytical frameworks for portfolios spanning 2-20+ products per manufacturer, ensuring accurate representation of market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and clinical differentiation factors.

  • Pipeline Evaluation & Strategic Forecasting - Conduct comprehensive analysis of FDA approval pipelines and therapeutic area trends to forecast long-range demand patterns and manufacturer impact across McKesson's distribution channels. Translate clinical trial data and regulatory timelines into actionable business intelligence for strategic planning and resource allocation.

  • Channel Strategy Advisory - Serve as subject matter expert in determining optimal distribution channel placement (Brand vs. Specialty Distribution) based on product characteristics, market access requirements, and economic considerations. Evaluate manufacturer channel requests to ensure alignment with product needs and McKesson's strategic objectives.

  • Internal Consulting & Cross-functional Support - Function as a strategic advisor to multiple internal stakeholder groups including product strategy, pricing, FP&A, and distribution planning teams. Field complex product questions and provide analytical insights to support business decisions across the enterprise.

  • Deal Guardrails & Strategic Review - Define and enforce deal parameters for routine and high-profile manufacturer negotiations. Contribute qualitative insights and market context beyond financial modeling to ensure comprehensive deal evaluation and risk assessment.

  • Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis - Monitor pharmaceutical industry trends, analyze competitor strategies, and synthesize market insights to inform strategic recommendations. Maintain current knowledge of therapeutic area developments, pricing dynamics, and access trends affecting established manufacturers.

Education

  • Licensed Pharmacist highly preferred

Critical Skills

  • 7+ years of experience in pharmaceutical industry, healthcare distribution, and/or management consulting with focus on life sciences

  • Demonstrated experience with complex financial modeling and business case development

  • Track record of translating clinical and market data into strategic business recommendations

  • Experience working with established pharmaceutical manufacturers and understanding of product lifecycle management

  • Success in cross-functional collaboration and internal consulting roles

Additional Skills

  • Deep understanding of pharmaceutical market dynamics, including pricing, reimbursement, and channel distribution strategies

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights

  • Expert knowledge of FDA regulatory processes and pharmaceutical product development timelines

  • Advanced proficiency in financial modeling tools and data visualization platforms

  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to present complex concepts to executive audiences

  • Strategic thinking with ability to balance multiple stakeholder perspectives

  • Understanding of both brand and specialty pharmaceutical distribution models

Who We Are

Akkadian Labs is a Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform that services some of the largest global enterprises and government agencies. Our platform reduces manual work by up to 90% and costs by as much as 50%, while improving accuracy and governance across leading Unified Communications platforms.

This ability to innovate at scale defines who we are: big enough to compete at the highest level, yet agile enough to stay ahead of a rapidly evolving market. Our culture is people-first, fully remote, and rooted in grit, clarity, trust, and respect, because when our people thrive, so do our customers.

Who You Are

We are hiring an Account Manager to lead retention, renewal, and expansion efforts across an assigned book of business. This is a quota-carrying role for someone who stays closely connected to customers year-round, builds momentum through proactive outreach, and turns account insight into growth opportunities.

The Account Manager serves as a primary relationship owner for their portfolio, helping customers realize ongoing value from the platform while identifying opportunities to deepen adoption, expand usage, and strengthen long-term partnerships. This role also works closely with systems integrators, channel partners, and reseller partners to support joint opportunities and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of customer accounts, managing day-to-day relationships and handling escalations with support as needed
  • Maintain a consistent cadence of outreach throughout the year to strengthen relationships, reinforce value, and stay ahead of renewal risk
  • Own subscription renewals across the assigned book of business, driving retention and contributing to overall revenue goals
  • Identify and advance expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including upsell, cross-sell, and pricing motions
  • Educate customers on platform value, functionality, and new features so they can maximize adoption and business impact
  • Recognize signs of under-utilization or account risk early and step in with recommendations, training, or resources before issues escalate
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews with selected customers to demonstrate value, review progress, and uncover growth opportunities
  • Maintain disciplined weekly forecasting in HubSpot for renewal and expansion opportunities, applying the MEDPICC framework to qualify and stage deals consistently
  • Partner with systems integrators, channel partners, and reseller partners to align on account strategy, support technical discussions, and present a unified value proposition
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Support teams to deliver a consistent customer experience and identify opportunities across the customer lifecycle
  • Use account data and analytics to identify trends, surface risks, and prioritize actions that support retention and growth
  • Travel to support customer relationship-building and key account engagements as needed

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of experience in software sales, specifically account management
  • Experience managing a book of business with quota and revenue responsibility
  • Demonstrated success with renewals and driving expansion revenue
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM platform
  • Experience in unified communications or collaboration platforms, or selling adjacent technologies is strongly preferred
  • Experience managing enterprise, government, healthcare, or finance accounts
  • Familiarity with MEDICC, MEDPICC, or a similar qualification framework
  • Ability to travel for customer meetings as needed
  • Ability to build strong customer relationships and maintain active engagement across a portfolio of accounts
  • Confidence leading renewal and expansion conversations and moving opportunities forward with urgency
  • Strong communication skills across customer-facing, partner-facing, and internal interactions
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment with multiple active priorities and revenue goals
  • Ability to translate product capabilities into practical customer value and business outcomes
  • Sound judgment in identifying account health signals, addressing objections, and responding proactively to risk
  • Discipline in forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM hygiene, with strong attention to opportunity status and next steps
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams and external partner networks

Benefits

We offer a fully remote environment, plus a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, company-paid life insurance and disability policies, 401(k) with a generous matching program, and paid time off.

raw.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
raw.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


About the Role

The Manager, Data Platform Governance & Operations is the strategic and operational leader of enterprise data governance, responsible for building and scaling governance infrastructure across Snowflake, AWS, and emerging data platforms. You will lead a small, high-performing team that includes senior engineers, oversee compliance and cost strategy, and partner with platform, engineering, and business teams to enable governed, self-service data access at scale.

This role bridges governance policy, platform engineering, and organizational leadership.

You will own the vision and execution of a code-first governance discipline, establish data governance culture, manage platform economics, and lead hiring and mentorship of technical talent. Success means embedding governance as an enabler, not a blocker, across hundreds of internal and external data consumers.

Key Collaborators: Data Engineering, Data Governance, SOX, AI/ML teams

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Governance & Platform Leadership

  • Define and evolve the enterprise data governance strategy, including RBAC patterns, compliance frameworks, cost optimization, and AI/ML data governance maturity roadmap
  • Own the Snowflake and AWS platform governance architecture, ensuring security, compliance, cost efficiency, and self-service enablement across environments
  • Partner with platform and engineering teams to embed governance capabilities (RBAC, network security, data masking, Iceberg integration) into Snowflake, AWS, Athena, and emerging platforms
  • Establish governance foundations for AI/ML initiatives, including Snowflake Cortex model governance, data lineage for AI pipelines, responsible data use policies, and Snowpark ML asset management

Governance Operations & Compliance

  • Operationalize enterprise data governance standards through automation, policies, and controls across Snowflake and AWS platforms
  • Own SOX compliance execution, including access controls, audit evidence generation, segregation-of-duties monitoring, and continuous compliance validation
  • Manage data catalog operations and metadata governance, ensuring accurate lineage, PII tagging, data masking policies, and stewardship practices across domains
  • Monitor governance adherence and compliance posture through automated reporting, anomaly detection, and visibility dashboards

Platform Economics & Cost Strategy

  • Own Snowflake and AWS platform cost management, including warehouse sizing strategy, compute optimization, cost attribution models, and chargeback frameworks
  • Establish cost observability through resource monitors, query tagging, and governance-driven cost reduction initiatives
  • Measure and report on platform ROI, governance impact (audit reduction, compliance velocity), and cost trends to leadership

Team Leadership, Hiring & Organizational Development

  • Build and mentor a high-performing governance team, including hiring senior technical talent, defining career paths, and fostering a culture of continuous learning
  • Partner with team members on platform architecture decisions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving
  • Establish scalable governance practices that enable the team to grow from 3 to 5 engineers to support emerging organizational needs

Self-Service Enablement & Stakeholder Management

  • Drive adoption of governed data products and self-service access models across the organization
  • Support onboarding of new teams and data domains through standardized governance patterns and best practices
  • Manage cross-functional relationships with Data Engineering, Security, Finance, and business stakeholders to ensure governance decisions align with platform roadmap and organizational priorities

What You Bring

Required Leadership Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in data governance, data platform operations, or data management, with 3+ years in a people leadership or technical lead role
  • Track record building and scaling governance programs in cloud-based environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor technical teams, with experience in hiring, performance management, and organizational development

Required Technical Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of Snowflake platform architecture, including RBAC design (functional vs. access roles), row-level security, data masking, network policies, authentication policies, resource optimization, and cost controls
  • AWS cloud proficiency, including S3, IAM, governance integrations, and multi-engine data architectures (Iceberg, Athena, Spark)
  • Enterprise compliance experience (SOX, SOC 2, or equivalent); expertise in access controls, audit evidence, and continuous compliance automation
  • Data catalog and metadata management expertise (Alation, Collibra, or similar); ability to design and oversee stewardship practices
  • Knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks) and governance capabilities such as cataloging, lineage, and access control

Preferred Expertise

  • Snowflake AI/ML governance: Experience with Cortex, Agents, Snowpark ML, and establishing governance for AI data pipelines
  • Platform economics: Experience with cost attribution, chargeback models, and ROI measurement for data platform investments
  • Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with Terraform or equivalent for governance automation and enforcement
  • Enterprise SaaS environment: Experience in organizations with distributed data ownership, self-service models, and rapid scaling

Core Competencies

  • Data Governance & Compliance Strategy
  • Snowflake & AWS Platform Architecture
  • Team Leadership, Hiring & Mentorship
  • Data Catalog & Metadata Management
  • Platform Economics & Cost Optimization
  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
  • AI/ML Data Governance
  • Servant Leadership & Organizational Development

Why You Will Succeed Here

  • Lead from principles: Servant leadership and empathy matter here. You will mentor technical talent and build a collaborative governance team.
  • Strategic influence: Governance decisions directly shape platform roadmap, cost efficiency, and organizational data culture.
  • Emerging technology: Work with Snowflake AI, multi-engine architectures, and data platforms at the frontier of innovation.
  • Scaling impact: Build governance infrastructure that serves thousands of internal and external data consumers.
  • Organizational growth: Hire, mentor, and grow the team as governance maturity and adoption expand.

Business Impact

  • Transforms governance from manual, audit-driven practice to a scalable, code-first discipline that reduces risk and accelerates innovation
  • Reduces security, compliance, and cost risks through standardized governance controls, continuous validation, and cost transparency
  • Enables self-service data access with built-in controls, accelerating analytics and AI initiatives while maintaining security guardrails
  • • Optimizes platform economics through cost controls, resource efficiency, and data-driven investment decisions

Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

  • Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.
  • A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. 
  • Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team.
  • We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases.
  • After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.


Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.

Get notified about relevant opportunities.


Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.


Employee Referral

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.


About Genesys:

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. With agentic AI at its core, Genesys Cloud™ is the AI-Powered Experience Orchestration platform that connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit .

You can expect a response within 24–48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email.

This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation—such as application follow-ups or resume submissions—may not receive a response.

Imagine yourself…

  • Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
  • Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project.
  • Collaborating with a vibrant, inclusive, global team.

At Veralto, our unifying purpose of Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™ is more than words: it’s a proven path towards positive change, improvement for our planet, and development for yourself.

Whether we’re ensuring the continued availability of clean drinking water, protecting our waterways, or enhancing the traceability, color accuracy, and packaging of everyday essentials, the work we do every day contributes to a safer world and a more sustainable future.

When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 14 operating companies and 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have boundless opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career.

We offer:

  • A flexible, remote-friendly work environment
  • Paid holidays and a permissive paid time off policy emphasizing flexibility and trust
  • Ongoing investment in your career through dedicated training, on-the-job development, and coaching
  • Competitive total rewards and benefits designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and success both at work and beyond.

Reporting to the Global Mobility Leader, the Global Mobility Analyst is responsible for supporting the administration, coordination, governance, and continuous improvement of Veralto’s global mobility and U.S. domestic relocation programs.

This position is part of the Global Mobility team and can be performed remotely from anywhere in Mexico, supporting associates and stakeholders across Veralto's global organization.

This role supports the execution of Veralto’s Global Mobility strategy, policies, and processes across the full mobility lifecycle, including business approval, relocation or assignment initiation, vendor coordination, transfer monitoring, compliance tracking, reporting, and assignment completion. The Global Mobility Analyst partners closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Tax, Payroll, Finance, Travel, HR Services, operating company stakeholders, and external vendors to deliver a consistent, compliant, and employee-centered mobility experience.

In this role, a typical day will look like:

  • Support the administration of global mobility programs, including international assignments, permanent transfers, cross-border arrangements, and U.S. domestic relocations from initiation through completion.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, HR Services, Legal, Tax, Payroll, Finance, Travel, operating company stakeholders, mobility vendors, and associates to deliver a seamless mobility experience.
  • Coordinate relocation, assignment, immigration, tax, and vendor services, including service initiation, issue resolution, invoice review, payment coordination, and relocation authorization tracking.
  • Monitor mobility milestones and required actions in Workday and related systems, including stakeholder communications, payroll updates, finance coordination, and assignment tracking.
  • Support mobility-related compliance activities and coordinate with Payroll, Tax, Compensation, Finance, Immigration, and Legal teams to ensure program adherence and risk mitigation.
  • Prepare and maintain mobility reporting, dashboards, tracking tools, compliance summaries, relocation spend reports, and management updates.
  • Develop and maintain mobility resources, including process maps, policy summaries, FAQs, stakeholder guides, training materials, and SharePoint content.
  • Identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, technology adoption, and continuous improvement to strengthen governance and simplify the mobility experience.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Accounting, Global Mobility, or a related field, or equivalent progressive experience.
  • Three to five years of experience in global mobility, relocation, international assignments, immigration, tax, payroll, compensation, HR operations, or related consulting within a multinational organization.
  • Working knowledge of mobility program administration, including international assignments, permanent transfers, domestic relocation, immigration coordination, payroll compliance, tax processes, vendor management, and cross-functional HR service delivery.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, SharePoint, Teams, Workday, and related reporting or case management tools.
  • Fluency in English required. Spanish or additional languages are a plus.

With annual sales of $5.5 billion, Veralto is a global leader in essential technology solutions with a proven track record of solving some of the most complex challenges we face as a society. Our industry-leading companies with globally recognized brands are building on a long-established legacy of innovation and customer trust to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future.

Veralto’s Water Quality companies—Aquatic Informatics, ChemTreat, Hach, Kipp & Zonen, McCrometer, Ott, Sea-Bird Scientific, Trojan Technologies, and XOS—manage, treat, purify, and protect the global water supply, from municipal and wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans. And our Product Quality & Innovation companies—Esko, Linx, TraceGains Videojet, and X-Rite Pantone—protect the world’s food, medicine, and essentials by tracking and authenticating the billions of goods that travel the global supply chain every day. Veralto is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, with 300+ locations worldwide.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

Why ClearStar Needs You:

ClearStar is seeking a hands-on Controller who will own accounting execution while driving meaningful transformation across the Finance function. This is not a maintenance role. The Controller will be expected to identify inefficiencies, eliminate low value work, improve financial operations, and help build a faster, more scalable accounting environment. The role owns the close, controls, cash management, tax compliance, and accounting systems while partnering closely with the CFO and supporting FP&A through accurate, reliable financial data.

  • Own and execute monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes
  • Maintain general ledger integrity, reconciliations, and accurate financial reporting
  • Improve close efficiency by reducing manual work and streamlining processes
  • Build and strengthen internal controls and maintain audit readiness
  • Lead external audits and ensure documentation and processes are audit quality
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across accounting workflows
  • Leverage AI and systems tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Partner cross functionally to streamline workflows and eliminate redundant processes
  • Track and report operational improvements and efficiency gains
  • Manage cash flow visibility, liquidity planning, and banking relationships
  • Drive disciplined working capital management
  • Own federal, state, and local tax filings and manage external tax advisors
  • Support practical and efficient tax strategies and compliance processes
  • Own NetSuite structure, integrity, reporting outputs, and system integrations
  • Ensure clean, reliable, and actionable financial data across systems
  • Lead and develop a small accounting team with clear expectations and accountability
  • Drive execution, continuous improvement, and operational discipline across the Finance function

What You'll Need:

  • 7–10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Controller-level responsibility
  • Strong GAAP knowledge with proven close and audit experience
  • Tax experience across multiple jurisdictions (federal, state, and local)
  • Demonstrated ability to improve processes and drive operational efficiency
  • Comfort operating in lean, fast-moving, and evolving environments
  • IFRS awareness and/or experience
  • Strong collaboration skills; comfortable partnering across sales, marketing, product, engineering, and finance

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA qualification preferred, but not required
  • Experience with SOC2, FCRA, and ASC 606 preferred, but not required
  • NetSuite experience strongly preferred
  • A dedicated home office space that is noise- and distraction-free with access to a reliable and secure high-speed internet connection. Cable or fiber internet connections (at least 75mbps download/10mbps upload) are preferred, as satellite connections often cannot support the technologies used to perform day-to-day task.

Who You Are:

You are a hands-on, high accountability accounting leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You bring a strong operational mindset, communicate clearly and directly, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and scale systems. You are comfortable driving change, challenging the status quo, and owning outcomes from start to finish.

Compensation & Benefits

Exciting and meaningful learning and development opportunities await at ClearStar! Join us on a journey of discovery and empowerment - where every opportunity is a steppingstone to success and growth. This position is also eligible for excellent benefits that include paid healthcare and life insurance premiums, low-cost dental and vision insurance, company-paid basic life insurance and a company-paid Short-Term Disability policy, employee assistance program, 401(k) matching up to 4%, time off, 9 company paid holidays, and 2 additional days of paid time off for volunteer activities.

The base salary range for this position is $165,000 – $180,000 annually, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for performance-based incentive compensation.

ClearStar is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications in relation to the requirements of the role.

ClearStar, Inc. welcomes applications from candidateslocatedin the following states: Alabama, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, andWashington.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Introduction

The Office of Information Services (OIS) is a shared service provider for the Oregon Health Authority (OHA) and Oregon Department of Human Services (ODHS). OIS provides the technology systems and services that support more than 18,000 OHA and ODHS agency staff at local offices and facilities around Oregon. These systems and services help the two agencies determine client service program eligibility; provide medical, housing, food, and job assistance; provide addiction, mental health, vocational and rehabilitative services; protect children, seniors and people with physical and/or developmental disabilities; process claims and benefits; manage provider licensing and Oregon hospital facilities; and promote and protect the Oregon public health.

The Office of Developmental Disabilities Services (ODDS) is a program of the Department of Human Services in coordination with the Oregon Health Authority. ODDS is refining Oregon's developmental disabilities system to be more person-centered through the DD Case Management and Provider Enrollment Management Project. eXPRS is a web-based system developed to manage long term care Medicaid services for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). The project has already improved some aspects of the system such as the Oregon Needs Assessment — a flexible and universal tool to collect information about what each individual needs.

OIS seeks an experiencedSenior Developerto support further development, enhancement, and improvement to the eXPRS application.

Scope of Work:

Contractor’s Key Person under this WOC will support the following needs of the Operations and Maintenance of the ODHS/ODDS eXPRS application:

  • Assist with identification and remediation of application bugs

Analista de Qualidade de Software (QA)

A Geopixel está com vaga aberta paraAnalista de Qualidade de Software (QA). Buscamos uma pessoa com perfil analítico e técnico, capaz de atuar na qualidade do produto durante todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, do entendimento dos requisitos à construção e evolução da cobertura de testes automatizados.

Nosso objetivo é evoluir de uma atuação de QAbaseada em execução de testes para uma abordagem de engenharia de qualidade, atuando no fluxo:

Requisito → Cenários BDD → Automação → Pipeline → Análise das falhas → Evolução da cobertura

Se você gosta de automação, tecnologia, melhoria contínua e acredita que qualidade deve ser construída durante todo o processo de desenvolvimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time.

#vempraGEO


Análise e planejamento

  • Participar do entendimento e refinamento dos requisitos, identificando cenários, regras de negócio e riscos.
  • Transformar requisitos e critérios de aceite em cenários de teste estruturados com BDD.
  • Planejar a estratégia de testes, definindo o que deve ser manual e o que deve ser automatizado.

Automação e execução

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir testes automatizados de interface com Cypress e Cucumber.
  • Integrar e acompanhar a execução dos testes automatizados nos pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Realizar testes exploratórios e manuais quando necessário, principalmente em funcionalidades novas ou cenários ainda não cobertos pela automação.

Análise e melhoria contínua

  • Analisar falhas identificadas na execução dos testes, investigar causas e colaborar com o time na resolução.
  • Identificar testes instáveis, redundantes ou de baixo valor, melhorando continuamente a suíte de automação.
  • Registrar e acompanhar defeitos com clareza, facilitando reprodução e correção.
  • Usar ferramentas de IA como apoio na criação de cenários, identificação de casos de borda, automação e análise de falhas.

Colaboração

  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com Desenvolvedores, Product Owners, UX e demais integrantes do time, contribuindo para que qualidade seja responsabilidade compartilhada.
  • Compartilhar conhecimentos e boas práticas, contribuindo para a evolução técnica do time de QA.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação

  • Ensino Superior ou Tecnólogo completoem Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos técnicos

  • Conhecimento sólido sobre testes de software e estratégias de qualidade.
  • Capacidade de interpretar requisitos e critérios de aceite e transformá-los em cenários de teste.
  • Conhecimento de BDD, Cucumber e Cypress para automação de testes de interface.
  • Conhecimento de JavaScript e/ou TypeScript aplicado a testes automatizados.
  • Conhecimento de testes funcionais, de regressão e exploratórios.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum) e do papel do QA durante a sprint.
  • Familiaridade com Git e controle de versão.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas a desenvolvimento e QA.

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência estruturando projetos de automação com Cypress + Cucumber + BDD.
  • Experiência com automação integrada a pipelines de CI/CD e testes automatizados de APIs REST.
  • Conhecimento de pirâmide de testes e definição do nível adequado de automação.
  • Experiência com métricas de qualidade e cobertura de testes.
  • Experiência utilizando IA para geração de cenários, automação, refatoração de testes ou análise de falhas.
  • Experiência na definição de padrões e boas práticas para automação de testes.

Informações adicionais

Nosso escritório está localizado em São José dos Campos, no estado de São Paulo.

Modelo de atuação: Home Office, com idas esporádicas ao escritório.
