raw.excerpt: About Feeld:Feeld is a dating app created intentionally for a community of authentic and open-minded humans seeking connection in a way that allows each member to come as they are.
raw.description:
About Feeld:

Feeld is a dating app created intentionally for a community of authentic and open-minded humans seeking connection in a way that allows each member to come as they are. Founded by designers, we believe that the "uncomfortable" can be made beautiful through intentional, elegant design. We provide a sanctuary for exploration, where human intimacy is treated with the artistry it deserves.

As societal norms shift and what was once considered "alternative" becomes part of the cultural zeitgeist, Feeld is evolving too. We aren't just keeping pace with changing norms; we are actively designing the frameworks that will define the future of human connection.

The Opportunity

Feeld has built one of the most culturally significant brands in the dating space. We have a massive, loyal community and a unique market position that our competitors cannot replicate. As we enter our next era, we are looking for our first-ever Chief Product Officer to take the reins of our product ecosystem and match our technical execution to our brand’s massive cultural ambition.

This is a defining role for the company. The CPO will not just manage our current product; they will be tasked with imagining the product for the existing and future needs of our communities and society. You will create a cohesive, intuitive, and beautifully designed product that members genuinely love by unifying vision, strategy, and execution across Product, Design, and Data in close partnership with Engineering.

This role requires both visionary leadership and practical engagement: the ability to map out where human intimacy is heading over the next decade, while simultaneously going deep into the weeds to evaluate what’s working, what isn’t, and why.

In short: You will be the architect of a new era of "Product-Led Excellence" at Feeld, turning progressive human values into a world-class digital experience.

Key Responsibilities

Product Vision, Strategy, and Societal Foresight

  • Anticipate the Future of Connection: Define and communicate a clear product point of view that anticipates macro societal shifts in relationships, intimacy, and community.
  • Multi-Year Roadmap: Build and execute a cohesive, multi-year product roadmap that unifies brand, design, and technical initiatives into a single, high-impact system.
  • Outcome-Driven Focus: Shift the organization from feature-led delivery to outcome-driven product development, ensuring work is focused on meaningful member moments, engagement, and retention.
  • Drive Coherence: Bring clarity where experiences feel fragmented, simplifying complexity and reducing friction across the end-to-end user journey.

Customer Obsession as a Living Practice

  • Direct Observation: Establish consistent, first-hand connection to members through direct observation, research, and qualitative insight to understand how their real-world needs are changing.
  • Deep Pain-Point Discovery: Shift discovery from feature ideation toward deep pain-point understanding, including identifying subtle and silent friction in the experience.
  • Community-First Culture: Foster a user-first culture where teams understand the emotional and functional realities of our diverse members, particularly women, LGBTQ+ communities, and non-monogamous people.
  • Translate Truths to Product: Convert deep member insights into prioritized, elegant product and design solutions that actually ship.

Craft, Quality, and Design Excellence

  • Uphold the Bar: Set a world-class standard for usability, aesthetics, and interaction quality across the product.
  • Make the Uncomfortable Beautiful: Partner deeply with Design to ensure Feeld remains visually, emotionally, and experientially distinct in the category.
  • Resolve Experience Friction: Act as a relentless steward of the overall experience, identifying and resolving persistent UX hurdles that limit member joy.
  • Deliberate Differentiation: Balance industry-standard expectations with visionary differentiation, knowing exactly where Feeld should follow industry conventions and where we must lead.

Execution, Systems, and Operating Model

  • Operational Alignment: Lead effective prioritization, planning, and decision-making across Product, Design, Data, and Engineering.
  • Velocity & Craft: Increase delivery speed and confidence while fiercely protecting product quality, user trust, and design craft.
  • Cross-Functional Clarity: Create absolute alignment across Engineering, Marketing, and Leadership regarding product priorities and the strategic rationale behind them.

Hands-on Evaluation and Informed Leadership

  • In-the-Weeds Understanding: Engage directly with the product and delivery processes to build first-hand understanding of technical constraints, strengths, and gaps.
  • Assess and Evolve: Work closely with Product and Design leadership to assess execution effectiveness and focus teams on the highest-leverage work.

Trust, Safety, and Integrity as Product Principles

  • Foundational Trust: Treat trust, safety, privacy, and respectful interaction as core product responsibilities, not an afterthought.
  • Systems Thinking for Safety: Ensure ethical and safety concerns are addressed through thoughtful product design, progressive systems thinking, and ongoing iteration.

Growth, Monetization, and Value Exchange

  • Experience-Led Growth: Improve activation, engagement, and conversion through product improvements that solve real member problems.
  • Ethical Monetization: Balance business outcomes with long-term relationships, ensuring monetization model decisions align with Feeld’s progressive brand and values.

AI as a Force Multiplier

  • Responsible Innovation: Develop a clear framework for how Feeld leverages AI to accelerate discovery, design, and delivery while maintaining strict member privacy and safety boundaries.

Key Objectives

  1. Elevate and Cohere the Experience: Create a product that feels intuitive, seamless, and emotionally resonant, closing the gap between Feeld’s high-concept brand and its day-to-day app experience.
  2. Future-Proof the Product: Successfully position the app to serve the next generation of users by creating features that accommodate fluid relationship structures and changing social norms.
  3. Drive Sustained Retention: Achieve measurable, long-term improvements in engagement and retention by solving real member problems.
  4. Establish Organizational Focus: Institutionalize a unified roadmap with clear priorities, shifting the company culture toward regular member observation, outcomes, and high-standard design craft.

Benefits

About us:

Feeld is an independent, experimental and fully remote organisation reshaping the dialogue on dating and sexuality. The company was founded in 2014 and has evolved since to become the open, distributed structure it is now. We have a naturally agile and fluid culture. The whole team is fully remote, which means you work where and when helps you perform at your best. We regard autonomy highly and treat our organisation as a product – we iterate, improve and test things internally to see what works best for everyone.

Our culture:

We believe in creating a safe work environment through humanity, fluidity, safety, transparency and progressiveness. When hiring, we look for culture add rather than culture fit.

Because we are a fully remote team, it’s especially important that we create an environment where our colleagues feel included and connected as humans.

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging at Feeld:

Feeld promotes open-mindedness, inclusion, diversity and kindness, both in the world and among our own workforce.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with a history of marginalisation, whether because of race, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, neurodivergence, national origin, disability (seen or unseen) or any confluence of intersectional identities.

Our goal is a barrier-free application process and working environment. If you require further details or assistance or have any questions about this process, please let us know at .

Compensation and perks:

We are conscious of how our work and decisions impact other humans and the environment. We design our product and organisation with consideration for the wellbeing of our Members and colleagues. Feeld’s way of working is designed to proactively prevent burnout and an “always on” culture. We believe in technology and working environments that enable people to live a meaningful, fulfilled life.

Therefore, we offer our staff:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • A fully remote working situation
  • Home office budget
  • Learning & development budget
  • On demand therapy sessions and mental health support via Spill
  • In-person meet ups

Our compensation system is one of the ways we work to uphold equity and inclusion at Feeld. Just as we strive to enable honest expression on our platform, we strive for openness of information within the organization. Internally, we keep decision-making transparent to keep each other accountable and make sure all voices are heard. That is why we offer a compensation system that is transparent, honest, and equitable. Additionally, we believe all humans deserve to earn a competitive wage, so we offer a Baseline Freedom Salary of £60,000 GBP per year for any role that indexes below £60,000 GBP per year.

Given the seniority of the Chief Product Officer role and the geographical diversity of our team across the US, Canada, and the UK, we provide tailored, competitive, and equitable compensation packages. We are committed to transparency and will discuss specific compensation details during our first conversation.

Our interview process:

  • Your first conversation with Feeld will be a screening call with our recruiter, where you’ll be able to ask - and receive answers - regarding any general questions you have and to confirm the role is a fit for what you’re seeking.
  • Your second conversation will connect you directly with the hiring manager for the role you’re applying to. Here, you’ll have a chance to ask more questions about the work you’ll be doing. This conversation will also focus on your past work experiences.
  • The next step for most of our roles is a candidate challenge. This is an evaluation of the skills relevant to be successful in this role and generally takes about an hour to complete.
  • Your third conversation allows you the opportunity to meet the team members you might be working with on a daily basis. Here, you’ll be able to ask questions about team processes, workflow, and the employee experience at Feeld.
  • We generally make an offer within 2 weeks of our final call, and offer a flexible start date that can begin as early as the next Monday after you sign our offer documentation.
  • Of note: all of our interviews are conducted remotely, and our interviewers will work with you to find an agreeable interview time based on mutual availability.

We understand we're asking you to invest your time and best efforts in our process, and are appreciative of getting the chance to better know who you are as a person and candidate. In return, we’re committed to offering transparent communication and prompt feedback as you navigate this application with us.

To find out more about Feeld, download our app (available on iOS and Android).

ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.

Position Summary

ThePrincipalAccount Manager serves as the worldwide business leader for one of ADI's most strategic Industrial customers. Theaccount manageris accountable for developing and executing a global growth strategy that drives profitable revenue expansion, strengthens executive relationships, influences customer technology roadmaps, and positions ADI as a preferred strategic partner across multiple geographies, business units, and functions. The role requires a unique combination of commercial leadership, technical credibility, strategic thinking, and the ability to lead through influence in a highly matrixed organization

  • Lead the team to driverevenue growth, market share expansion, and strategic design wins across all customer business units, regions, and product portfolios.

  • Influence customertechnologyroadmaps, platform architectures, and investment priorities through early engagement and differentiated solution strategies.

  • Identify, prioritize, and drive the highest-value strategic opportunities while ensuring alignment between customerobjectivesand ADI growth initiatives.

  • Develop a deep understanding of the customer's business, market position, ecosystem, competitive landscape, and long-term strategic direction, including the customer's customers, partners, and influencers.

  • Lead global cross-functional teams through influence, aligning Sales, FAEs, Business Units, Operations, Marketing, and Executive Leadership behind a common account strategy.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer within ADI, communicating market insights, product requirements, competitive dynamics, and strategic opportunitiestobusiness unit and executive leadership.

  • Advocate for and help shape ADI investment priorities, strategic partnerships, and solution roadmaps that support long-term customer and market growth.

  • Lead Executive Business Reviews, strategic negotiations, partnership agreements, and critical customer escalations to strengthen ADI's position and influence.

  • Drive disciplined account planning, forecasting, opportunity management, relationship mapping, and execution against global growthobjectives.

  • Coach, mentor, and enable account team members to execute strategic selling methodologies and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering,business, or related field

  • 10+ years of semiconductor, industrial technology, technical sales, business development, applications engineering, or strategic account management experience.

  • Proven success managing large, complex global or multinational accounts.

  • Demonstrated ability to build,maintainand leverage executive relationships to drive strategic outcomes.

  • Strong commercial, financial, and business planning acumen.

  • Deep understanding of Industrial Automation, Robotics, Process Automation, Energy, Building Automation, or related industrial markets.

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in highly matrixed organizations without direct authority.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.

  • Willingness to travel globally (approximately 30-40%).

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

At Leica Microsystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Shape the Future with Us!

At Leica Microsystems, we have been shaping the future for over 175 years with groundbreaking optical and digital solutions. With a culture rooted in customer focus, innovation, and teamwork, we lead the market in microscopy, imaging, and analysis, unveiling the invisible and empowering our customers to build a better, healthier world.

Joining Leica Microsystems means contributing to scientific discoveries and supporting surgeons in making critical decisions. Our advanced microscopes and AI-based image analysis solutions enable users to gain profound insights into development and engineering challenges. Here, you will work on meaningful projects alongside passionate colleagues, driving progress and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Advanced Workflow Specialist – Electron Microscopy Sample Preparation (d/f/m) plays a key customer-facing role within the EMEA Business Development team. The position supports pre-sales and post-sales activities by delivering expert application knowledge, demonstrations, trainings, and workflow optimization for electron microscopy sample preparation solutions.

By acting as a technical and scientific bridge between customers, Sales, Business Development, Product Management, and R&D, this role directly contributes to customer success, adoption of advanced workflows, and Leica Microsystems’ growth across the EMEA region.

The role is remote, with regular 40-50% travel across the EMEA region.
We would like the successful candidate to be based in the Milan area due to the high concentration of our customers in the region and Milan's excellent international connectivity through its airports, enabling efficient travel across Europe.

This position reports to the EMEA Business Development leadership and is part of the EMEA Business Development Team, Sample Preparation (SU).

The role is remote, with regular travel across the EMEA region.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Deliver pre-sales and post-sales application support, including on-site and virtual demonstrations, customer trainings, and workflow optimization.

  • Plan, execute, and support customer workshops, seminars, and advanced application sessions focused on electron microscopy sample preparation workflows.

  • Support marketing initiatives through scientific content contributions for webinars, conferences, workshops, and promotional materials.

  • Develop and contribute to application data, success stories, and reference workflows that support the commercial organization.

  • Ensure accurate and timely documentation of customer activities, demos, and trainings in CRM systems (e.g., SFDC).

D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: .

About the role

D-Wave is seeking an experienced Vice President of Systems Engineering to build and lead a world-class Systems Engineering organization supporting our Gate Model Quantum Computing program. In this leadership role, you will define the systems engineering strategy, architecture, integration, and technical executionrequiredto deliver scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing systems.

You will lead the organization responsible for ensuring the Quantum Processing Unit (QPU), control electronics, cryogenic systems, calibration software, runtime software, cloud services, and system monitoringoperateas a single, integrated platform that meets product, performance, and reliabilityobjectives.

Working closely with Product Management, Research, Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, and Executive Leadership, you willestablishthe engineering processes, technical governance, and organizational capabilities needed to transform breakthrough quantum technology into commercial products.

What you'll do

  • Define and execute the Systems Engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap supporting D-Wave's Gate Model Quantum Computing platform
  • Establish and continuously improve systems engineering processes, architecture governance, requirements management, verification, validation, and technical readiness practices across the organization
  • Partner with Product Management to translate customer and business requirements into achievable product specifications and integrated system architectures
  • Own the end-to-end system architecture, including decomposition of system requirements into subsystem requirements, interfaces, and verification strategies across the QPU, cryogenic systems, control electronics, calibration software, runtime software, and LEAP Quantum Cloud Service
  • Lead cross-functional system integration, verification, validation, and technical execution to ensure delivery of highly integrated quantum computing platforms
  • Drive resolution of complex system-level trade-offs while balancing technical performance, schedule, risk, manufacturability, and productobjectives
  • Build strong partnerships across physics, hardware, software, product management, manufacturing, and operations to ensure alignment throughout thedevelopmentlifecycle
  • Build, lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing Systems Engineering organization, including engineering managers and senior technical leaders
  • Develop organizational capabilities, engineering standards, and technical governance that enable scalable product development across multiple generations of quantum computing systems
  • Represent Systems Engineering as a senior technical leader with executive leadership, customers, strategic partners, and external stakeholders

About You

  • Bachelor's orMaster's degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, ora relatedtechnical discipline
  • 15+ years of progressive systems engineering experience leading development of complex hardware and software products involving advanced technologies
  • 10+ years leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations delivering integrated technical systems
  • Demonstrated success defining system architectures and delivering large-scale products from concept through commercialization
  • Extensive experience in systems engineering disciplines including architecture, requirements management, interface definition, system integration, verification, and validation
  • Proven ability to build, mentor, and lead engineering managers and highly technical multidisciplinary teams
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and executive leadership skills with the ability to align diverse technical organizations around commonobjectives
  • Demonstrated experience driving technical strategy while balancing engineering excellence, product delivery, schedule, and organizational priorities

A D-Waver's DNA

  • We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
  • We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
  • We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
  • As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.

Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.

During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) offerings. The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level.

Inclusion:

We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform - not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation
  • Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed
  • Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking
  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required
  • Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: up to $5 per hour equivalent depending on the project
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

raw.excerpt: About Cloudli Communications Cloudli Communications delivers modern business communication solutions designed to help organizations connect more effectively with their customers.
raw.description:
About Cloudli Communications
Cloudli Communications delivers modern business communication solutions designed to help organizations connect more effectively with their customers. From unified communications (UCaaS) and SIP trunking to IP fax and messaging services, Cloudli provides reliable, scalable, and secure platforms backed by a dedicated onboarding and implementation team.
We are currently seeking a Customer Implementation Project Manager (CIPM) to lead cross-functional implementation projects for our business clients, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery of Cloudli’s communication solutions.
Position Overview
The Customer Implementation Project Manager is responsible for managing end-to-end technical implementations for new and existing customers — from project kickoff to service activation. This role requires strong coordination between Customers, Partners, Sales Engineering, LNP, and Development teams to deliver projects on time and within scope. The ideal candidate will blend strong project management discipline with technical acumen in VoIP, UCaas, SIP, and networking environments.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead multiple simultaneous customer implementation projects, ensuring adherence to timelines, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the onboarding lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Sales, Sales Engineering, LNP, Support, Network Operations, and Development) to ensure all technical components are properly configured and validated.
  • Conduct project kickoff meetings to review requirements, call flows, network readiness, and porting details.
  • Manage project documentation, including intake forms, configuration details, and change control.
  • Develop and maintain proficiency in the Cloudli Connect VoIP platform to provision, validate, and troubleshoot customer solutions during implementation.
  • Track and report project progress, risks, and dependencies to internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and improve onboarding processes, tools, and customer experience.
  • Utilize Zendesk, and internal tools for task tracking, reporting, and status visibility.
  • Support ongoing transformation initiatives that enhance project visibility and efficiency across teams.
Qualifications
Required:
  • 5-7 years of experience in technical project management, implementation, or customer implementation in telecommunications, UCaaS, or managed services.
  • Solid understanding and experience troubleshooting VoIP, SIP trunking, and network topology.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and deliver results under tight deadlines.
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Proficiency with Zendesk, MS Excel, and project tracking tools.
  • Customer-first mindset with the ability to translate technical language into customer-friendly terms.
Preferred:
  • PMP, CAPM, or Agile/Scrum certification.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, SIP troubleshooting.
  • Experience in a UCaaS, SaaS or fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Key Competencies
  • Technical aptitude: Understands telecom infrastructure and service dependencies.
  • Project leadership: Confidently drives cross-team collaboration and accountability.
  • Customer experience focus: Prioritizes clarity, communication, and smooth transitions.
  • Analytical mindset: Uses data to track progress and drive efficiency improvements.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a rapidly evolving, growth-oriented environment.

At UniSystems, we are working towards turning digital visions into reality. We are continuously growing and we are looking for a Data Protection Compliance Expert to join our UniQue team.

What will you be doing in this role:

  • Ensure compliance of IT operations with data privacy and data protection standards, laws and regulations.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, auditing and compliance testing activities in order to Ensure data and privacy compliance.
  • Advise on data protection matters, in particular in the context of personal data processing.
  • Conduct privacy impact assessments.
  • Write and/or review records of processing activity on personal data for data controllers and privacy statements.
  • Develop, maintain, communicate and train upon the data privacy policies and procedures.
  • Provide legal advice and guidance on data privacy and data protection standards, laws and regulations.
  • Enforce and advocate organization’s data privacy and protection program.
  • Ensure that data owners, holders, controllers, processors, subjects, internal or external partners and entities are informed about their data protection rights, obligations and responsibilities.
  • Monitor audits and data protection related training activities.
  • Develop and propose staff awareness training to achieve compliance and foster a culture of data protection within the organization.

Requirements

What do you need to succeed in this position?

  • A Master's degree in a relevant field and at least 5 years of IT relevant professional experience and 4 years in a similar position.
  • At least 5 years of personal data protection compliance experience in an ICT, EU institutional, public-sector or similarly technology-heavy environment, including hands-on work with real systems, services or processing activities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience preparing, updating or reviewing RoPAs, DPIAs, DPA, TIA or related personal data protection documentation for real systems or processing activities, including data mapping and obtaining or validating input from system owners, technical owners, architects, operations, cybersecurity/SOC teams or vendors.
  • At least 2 years of experience analysing and documenting technical arrangements relevant to personal data protection, including access rights, privileged access, logs or SIEM/log exports, retention, hosting, data flows, support access, transfers, processors or subprocessors.
  • At least 2 years of experience coordinating multiple concurrent personal data protection work items and driving them to closure, including prioritization, ownership and deadline tracking, follow-up, escalation, closure evidence and version control.
  • Excellent knowledge and understanding of the EU data protection legislation and regulations.
  • Excellent knowledge of data protection standards, policies, methodologies and frameworks.
  • Excellent knowledge and understanding of legal, regulatory and legislative compliance requirements, recommendations and best practices.
  • Excellent knowledge and understanding of IT Operations and IT Services delivery.
  • Practical experience with privacy impact assessment standards, methodologies and frameworks .
  • Practical experience writing and reviewing records of processing activity on personal data for data controllers and privacy statements.
  • Required certificates, at least 3 of the among: CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), GSNA (GIAC Certified Systems and Network Auditor), GCCC (GIAC Certified Critical Controls), ISO 27001 Lead implementer, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, ISO 27005 Risk Manager, CAP ((ISC)2 Certified Authorization Professional), CRISC (ISACA Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control), CISSP-ISSMP ((ISC)2 Certified Information Systems Security Management Professional), GIAC Certified ISO-27000 Specialist or equivalent certification recognized internationally.
  • Excellent command of spoken and written English (C1).

At Uni Systems, we are providing equal employment opportunities and banning any form of discrimination on grounds of gender, religion, race, color, nationality, disability, social class, political beliefs, age, marital status, sexual orientation or any other characteristics. raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Bot Developers (WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot API, Discord API) to join the Tendem project () and build conversational bots and messaging-platform integrations for real-world applications. In this role, you'll use your bot engineering expertise, conversational design skills, and quality-focused approach to build reliable, useful bots and messaging integrations that deliver a great user experience. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor bot implementations to improve correctness, reliability, maintainability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and build stable, user-friendly bot experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

raw.excerpt: Working at Frontier Airlines At Frontier, our mission is to Make Every Flight Count.
raw.description:
Working at Frontier Airlines

At Frontier, our mission is to Make Every Flight Count. That mission guides how we support our customers, our people and the operation every day.

As a Frontier employee, your work connects to more than a single role. Whether you’re supporting flights, helping customers, maintaining aircraft, leading teams or working behind the scenes, you help create a travel experience that is safe, reliable and built around value.

Our work is guided by our core values: customer first, safety always, operational excellence and one team. These values shape how we make decisions, support each other and deliver for the people who count on us.

Support for work, life and travel

Frontier offers benefits, programs and travel privileges designed to support eligible employees at work and beyond. Availability may vary by role, employment status, eligibility, location, schedule, applicable policies and current plan details.

Depending on role and eligibility, available benefits and programs may include:

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement savings options
  • Paid holidays, vacation time and sick time
  • Travel privileges on Frontier Airlines and participating partner airlines, based on current program rules and availability
  • Buddy passes, based on eligibility and program rules
  • Travel-related discounts and employee discounts on select products, services and vendors
  • A hybrid schedule for eligible headquarters roles based in Denver, Colorado
  • Business casual dress options for eligible corporate and support roles
  • Employee support programs and resources, including the HOPE League, Frontier Airlines’ nonprofit organization

About Frontier Airlines

Frontier Airlines is a Denver-based airline serving destinations across the United States and select international markets. Our people support every part of the travel journey, from airport operations and flight crews to aircraft maintenance, customer support, corporate teams and more.

We’re focused on delivering meaningful value by making travel more accessible, practical and easy to personalize for our customers. Across the airline, our teams help support a safe, reliable and efficient operation while continuing to strengthen the experience for the people who choose Frontier.

What Will You Be Doing?

The Manager, Customer Care Partner Delivery owns end-to-end vendor performance, operational execution, and customer resolution outcomes across Frontier Customer Care partner-supported channels, including Voice, Chat, Complaints, Back Office, Specialty Support, Customer Recovery, Escalations, Refunds, Baggage Support, and regulatory-related workflows.

This role serves as the primary operational liaison between Frontier Airlines and BPO partner organizations, ensuring consistent service delivery, customer experience execution, policy adherence, workforce readiness, quality partnership, performance accountability, and continuous improvement across assigned vendors, sites, and workstreams.

Essential Functions

  • 35% - Partner Delivery, Vendor Governance & Operational Performance
    • Own daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance outcomes across Voice, Chat, Complaints, Back Office, and Specialty support operations.
    • Lead BPO partner governance routines, business reviews, performance discussions, corrective action planning, documented follow-up, and service delivery accountability.
    • Monitor and manage key operational indicators including service level, AHT, abandonment, queue health, productivity, FCR, CSAT/NPS, backlog health, aging work items, and SLA adherence.
    • Ensure consistent execution of approved policies, procedures, customer experience standards, and operational expectations across partner locations, geographies, and workstreams.
  • 25% - Customer Experience, Complaints, Escalations & Recovery
    • Oversee partner execution for customer complaints, escalations, executive inquiries, high-risk customer issues, customer recovery programs, refunds, baggage support, accommodations, and regulatory-related workflows.
    • Identify repeat contact drivers, complaint trends, service gaps, customer pain points, and frontline barriers impacting resolution quality and customer effort.
    • Partner with Customer Advocacy, Airport Operations, Legal, Revenue Operations, Digital, Loyalty, Quality, Training, Workforce Planning, and Analytics teams to resolve issues and improve the end-to-end customer journey.
    • Ensure customer commitments, escalation paths, documentation requirements, and resolution expectations are followed timely and consistently.
  • 20% - Operational Readiness, Risk Mitigation & Incident Response
    • Lead operational readiness activities for product launches, policy changes, process updates, system or tool changes, seasonal volume increases, IROPs, and customer-impacting incidents.
    • Coordinate cross-functional communication, contingency planning, partner execution, risk documentation, and mitigation plans during high-volume or high-risk events.
    • Partner with Workforce, Quality, Training, and Knowledge Management teams to ensure partner teams have the capacity, coaching, guidance, and documentation needed to support customers effectively.
  • 15% - Business Insights, Root Cause & Continuous Improvement
    • Interpret performance trends, reporting, customer feedback, complaint data, QA insights, and operational observations to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.
    • Prepare executive-ready updates, performance summaries, operational narratives, and action plans for leadership review.
    • Drive process improvements, automation opportunities, digital/self-service enhancements, and operational standardization that reduce customer effort, repeat demand, and process waste.
  • 5% - Compliance, Documentation & Controls
    • Support compliance awareness and operational control expectations related to customer handling, refunds, accommodation programs, complaint workflows, regulatory processes, and documentation standards.
    • Maintain audit-ready documentation, support knowledge base/process updates, and escalate risks requiring leadership, policy, or cross-functional decisioning.

Other Functions

  • Support special projects, pilots, operating model changes, partner transitions, and customer experience initiatives that improve Customer Care service delivery.
  • Participate in cross-functional planning with Quality, Training, Digital, Airport Operations, Customer Advocacy, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, Analytics, Legal, Loyalty, and Workforce Planning teams.
  • Assist with knowledge base, training, reporting, process documentation, and partner communication updates related to assigned workstreams.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support Customer Care, vendor operations, and partner delivery objectives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Operations Management, Customer Experience, Aviation, Hospitality, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 7 years of leadership experience in Contact Center Operations, Customer Care, Customer Advocacy, Vendor Operations, Back Office Operations, Specialty Support, Complaints, Escalations, Customer Recovery, or Customer Experience environments required.
  • Experience managing outsourced vendor or BPO relationships required.
  • Experience leading performance reviews, operational governance, service delivery management, corrective action planning, and cross-functional issue resolution required.
  • Experience managing complaint resolution, customer recovery, escalations, refunds, baggage support, regulatory operations, or specialty support workflows preferred.
  • Airline, travel, hospitality, telecommunications, or high-volume customer support experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of contact center operations, Voice, Chat, Back Office, Specialty Support, complaints, escalations, customer recovery, vendor governance, and BPO support models.
  • Ability to lead partner accountability through performance management, action planning, root-cause analysis, and timely follow-through.
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret service levels, queue health, AHT, abandonment, productivity, FCR, CSAT/NPS, backlog, aging, SLA performance, complaint trends, and quality insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to produce executive-ready summaries, operational updates, and clear partner direction.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and build partnerships across internal teams, external vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong customer recovery, problem-solving, prioritization, decision-making, escalation management, and continuous improvement skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and ability to use operational reporting tools, dashboards, customer care systems, or case management platforms preferred.

Equipment Operated

Standard office equipment, including PC, copier, fax machine, printer

Work Environment

Typical office environment, adequately heated and cooled. Position may require collaboration with remote, offshore, and multi-site vendor partners through phone, chat, email, video conferencing, and collaboration tools.

Physical Effort

Light physical effort required by handling objects up to 20 pounds occasionally and/or up to 10 pounds frequently.

Supervision Received

General Direction: The incumbent normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work and receives general instructions on new assignments.

Positions Supervised

No direct reports anticipated unless assigned. Provides functional leadership, operational direction, and performance accountability to BPO partner leadership teams, vendor operations teams, and cross-functional stakeholders supporting Customer Care delivery.

Salary Range: $81,752 - $108,511

Please note this role has a closing date of on or before 10/1/26 midnight MST.

Workplace Policies

Disclaimer: The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature and level of work required of the referenced position; they are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of individuals in this position. Please be advised that duties and expectations of this position may be subject to change.

Frontier Airlines, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and, as such, is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, pregnancy, genetic information, citizenship status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Frontier Airlines is a Zero Tolerance Drug-Free Workplace. All prospective employees are subject to pre-employment testing for the following drugs and their metabolites: Marijuana, Cocaine, Amphetamines, Opioids and Phencyclidine (PCP). Further, any applicant who is found to have tested positive on any required drug or alcohol test at a former employer will be considered ineligible for employment with Frontier.

raw.title: Principal Architect - Identity, Access, and Management (Remote, US)
raw.excerpt: Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem.
raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Define and own identity, access management, and security architecture for Lumen's NaaS platform,
customer-facing digital services, and AI/agent ecosystems. This role embeds security architecture directly
into the Digital Journey Architecture and Solutions organization - providing the team with IAM and security
expertise at the point of design, not as a downstream review function.The scope spans customer portal identity (who can access what and how), API security and authentication standards (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML), SSO integration (including Entra B2C for enterprise and government customers), FedRAMP and compliance-aligned security architecture, and the emerging security
requirements of agentic AI systems. This role also serves as the primary DJAS interface for security
architecture related to complex multi-cloud networking integrations and Lumen's public sector initiatives.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own IAM strategy and target-state architecture across Lumen's NaaS identity ecosystem:
    LIAM/ECAPS, Microsoft Entra ID/B2C, AWS IAM.
  • Design and operationalize Zero Trust identity principles: continuous verification, risk-based access,
    least privilege enforcement.
  • Architect customer identity and access management (CIAM): web portal, mobile, and API access
    patterns with security and customer experience in balance.
  • Define authentication and federation standards: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML - enforced across
  • APIs and customer-facing surfaces.
  • Design SSO architecture across NaaS portal, partner portals, and government-facing services (Entra
    B2C).
  • Develop IAM governance frameworks: RBAC/ABAC models, access lifecycle, entitlement review, audit
    evidence.
  • Define IAM-as-Code practices: Terraform-based identity configuration, version-controlled, auditable
  • Architect security for agentic AI systems: agent authentication, authorization boundaries, audit trails for
    AI-generated actions, token lifecycle management for agents.
  • Provide security architecture for FedRAMP-aligned government initiatives: boundary preservation,
    tokenization patterns, identity flow compliance.
  • Serve as the embedded DJAS security architect for multi-cloud networking integration: define IAM and
    security boundary requirements across cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-physical network interconnects
  • Conduct security architecture reviews on NaaS designs: threat modeling, attack surface analysis,
    risk-based recommendations.
  • Define security NFRs for DJAS architecture work: what every design must address from a security
    perspective regardless of work type.
  • Partner with Lumen's Security team (not owned by DJAS) and bring the security perspective into DJAS
    design work proactively.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information security, or related field with 12+
    years of relevant experience or
  • Master's degree with 10+ years of relevant experience
  • AI-first practitioner - actively integrates AI tools (LLMs, coding assistants, AI-powered analysis and
    design tools) as a routine part of architecture and engineering work, not as an occasional experiment.
  • Candidates must demonstrate specific, current examples of how AI has meaningfully accelerated or
    improved their work.
  • CISSP, CISM, or equivalent security certification preferred
  • Deep expertise in enterprise IAM architecture: Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, AWS IAM - production
    scale
  • Expert knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML - not just implementation but architecture
    and standards governance
  • Customer identity (CIAM) experience: portal, mobile, and API access patterns
  • Zero Trust architecture principles and implementation experience
  • RBAC/ABAC model design at enterprise scale
  • FedRAMP, FISMA, or NIST 800-53 compliance architecture experience
  • Security architecture for API ecosystems: API gateway security, token management, key rotation,
    scope enforcement
  • Threat modeling disciplines (STRIDE or equivalent)

Preferred:

  • Experience securing agentic AI systems or autonomous workflow platforms

We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

The Opportunity

ThisEngineering Manager, Cloud Software Platform Practice position can work out remotely within the U.S.

The Engineering Manager, Cloud Software Platform Practice leads and develops a team of cloud software engineers responsible for the platform capabilities that power our digital ecosystem for healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and caregivers. The Cloud Platform Practice delivers and evolves cloud-based services, APIs, medical data platforms, messaging and event-streaming technologies, and other shared platform capabilities.

Partnering with the Cloud Platform Practice Owner, Product leaders, and technical stakeholders, this role translates strategy into execution, supports delivery commitments, and fosters a culture of trust, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning. The Engineering Manager provides coaching, removes barriers, and helps engineers grow while maintaining strong engineering standards and platform reliability.

Reporting to the Cloud Platform Practice Owner, the Engineering Manager is accountable for building a high-performing team, balancing delivery with long-term platform sustainability, and driving reliable, secure, and scalable solutions that create business and customer value.

What You’ll Work On

  • Lead and develop a team of cloud software engineers by providing coaching, mentoring, feedback, and growth opportunities aligned with organizational objectives.

  • Design and implement services and components utilizing Go for cloud-based platforms.

  • Develop high-volume, low-latency services for a global healthcare platform.

  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to develop and integrate APIs that empower users to share and utilize their medical data in partner systems.

  • Collaborate directly with Information Security teams to design and implement secure solutions.

  • Ensure platform performance, scalability, reliability, and uptime while maintaining high standards of engineering quality.

  • Contribute to significant architectural and operational decisions in collaboration with Architecture and Platform leadership.

  • Partner with technical product owners and business stakeholders to align priorities, remove barriers, and ensure successful delivery of platform capabilities.

  • Balance near-term delivery goals with long-term platform sustainability through investments in quality, security, observability, operability, performance, and technical debt reduction.

  • Encourage pragmatic experimentation and innovation by evaluating new ideas based on customer needs, technical evidence, risk, and expected value.

  • Build trusted relationships across Product, Security, Quality, Regulatory, and other business and technology teams.

  • Lead technical planning, design reviews, and engineering best practices across the Cloud Software Platform Practice.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, making recommendations that support innovation and business objectives.

  • Support company initiatives and comply with FDA and other applicable global regulatory requirements.

​

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, other relevant field or equivalent experience.

  • Minimum 8 yearsof related experience or a Master’s degree and 6+ years of related experience.

  • A leadership approach grounded in humility, curiosity, accountability, and service to the team.

  • Experience supporting engineers who work across multiple product teams, programs, or matrixed organizational structures.

  • Software engineering experience with cloud-based or distributed systems and sufficient technical fluency to understand context, ask effective questions, and participate credibly in architecture, risk, and delivery discussions.

  • Ability to coach engineers in problem-solving, judgment, and professional growth while fostering a shared mentoring model in which Principal, Staff, Senior, and other engineers contribute their technical expertise.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining highly complex asynchronous messaging and backend processing jobs.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining highly complex asynchronous messaging and backend processing jobs.

  • Experience translating business and product goals into engineering priorities, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.

  • Ability to balance delivery speed with reliability, security, quality, maintainability, and long-term platform health.

  • Comfortable working asynchronously with a distributed team

  • Strong written, verbal, and listening skills, including the ability to communicate technical choices, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong Computer Science fundamentals and experience with software development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading teams that build production software in Go or another modern cloud-native language.

  • Experience with public-cloud platforms and managed database, messaging, event-streaming, API, and service technologies.

  • Experience treating an internal platform as a product, with a focus on developer experience, adoption, reliability, and measurable value.

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

At Crumdale, people come first. We strive to make a positive impact on the people we serve. We believe this starts with the passion and purpose of our team. Our company culture is rooted in alignment, innovation, and integrity.

Crumdale Specialty is seeking a Captive Sales Advisor to partner with Regional Sales Directors to win alternative funding opportunities specifically by turning “captive” from a conceptual idea into a clear, finance‑ready decision for employers.

This role elevates the effectiveness of our field teams by simplifying technical components of self-funding, captives, stop‑loss strategy, and cost-containment solutions.   • Maintain disciplined timelines and ensure seamless handoffs into onboarding.

  • Develop field-ready materials that increase speed-to-proposal and close rates.
  • Contribute to internal training, content creation, and tools that simplify complexity for both buyers and brokers.
  • Represent Crumdale’s captive capabilities with clarity and authority in the market.

Requirements

  • Telemedicine
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Life, AD&D, Disability

  • Microsoft Fabric, specifically dataflows Gen2 and lakehouse patterns. This engagement is moving from emailed static extracts toward dataflows connected to source semantic models, and that transition needs someone who has done it before.
  • Power Automate for scheduled ingestion and file handling, including flows that move recurring extracts from email into managed storage.
  • Power Apps and Dataverse. The client is standing up a staffing plan management application on ServiceNow and has related Power Platform activity; familiarity is needed to integrate against these rather than build them.
  • SQL at a strong level, including window functions, common table expressions, and query optimization against large transactional tables.
  • Dimensional modeling. Must be able to design star schemas, resolve mixed grain fact tables, and manage role playing date dimensions. This project combines employee snapshots, position records, hiring actions, training assignments, and separations in one model.
  • Slowly changing dimensions and effective dated records. HR data is effective dated by nature and point in time headcount is a non-trivial calculation.
  • Data warehouse or lakehouse design experience. Prior experience standing up a central data hub that feeds reporting, rather than pointing reports directly at extracts.
  • Entity resolution across systems that do not share a common key, including building and maintaining crosswalk tables.
  • Data quality profiling and reconciliation: identifying duplicates, orphaned records, unmapped values, and conflicting counts between sources, then documenting the resolution.

raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Ireland

About the team

As a Premier Support Manager (PSM), you will be part of the Kinaxis Premier Support Team delivering post-sales support services to strategic enterprise customers.

The PSM serves as the primary point of contact for support and operational health activities, ensuring an exceptional customer experience through proactive service management, escalation management and operational oversight. Working closely with customers and internal Kinaxis teams, the PSM develops a deep understanding of customer systems, support requirements and business priorities.

In addition to coordinating support activities, the PSM proactively monitors customer environment health, reviews operational trends and highlights observations, emerging risks and opportunities for improvement. By combining data analysis, customer engagement and knowledge of Kinaxis best practices, the PSM helps customers better understand their environment and make informed decisions.

If you want to be part of a team that challenges you, moves fast, improves constantly, and makes a difference, let’s talk.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy

What you will do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for support escalations and critical situations.
  • Lead regular service reviews, support case reviews, and operational discussions to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and outcomes.
  • Develop trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and serve as an advocate for customer needs within Kinaxis.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer environments, business processes and operational objectives.
  • Monitor customer environment health using Kinaxis reporting, monitoring and analytics tools.
  • Analyze trends in system usage, performance, support activity, and operational metrics to identify emerging risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide guidance and recommendations aligned with Kinaxis best practices to improve operational effectiveness and customer experience.
  • Maintain awareness of customer deployments, significant business events and operational changes that may impact system performance or support requirements.
  • Collaborate with Support, Cloud Services, Product Management, and Customer Success teams to drive successful customer outcomes.
  • Share support insights, trends and investigation outcomes with customers, providing context, guidance and actionable next steps.

What we are looking for

  • Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5-7 years of progressive experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in a customer-facing role, including service delivery, support account management or technical account management.
  • Experience managing strategic enterprise customers and building relationships across multiple stakeholder levels.
  • Ability to work independently, while collaborating effectively across multiple business functions.
  • Experience managing high-priority issues, customer escalations, and complex support situations.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify patterns, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience leveraging monitoring, reporting, analytics, or dashboarding tools to evaluate system performance and customer health.
  • Demonstrates curiosity and a proactive approach to uncovering risks, investigating anomalies, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, including presenting information to technical and business audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

#Senior

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at

This position is for our subsidiary:

Allcat Claims Service, LLC

To know more, visit us at

Position Summary

The Contract and Litigation Paralegal provides substantive legal and administrative support across multiple functions, including contract lifecycle management and litigation support. This role works closely with in-house counsel to draft, review, and track contracts, while also assisting with case management, discovery, and preparation for active or pending litigation. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable managing competing deadlines across both transactional and litigation workstreams, and able to work independently with sound judgment on matters of moderate complexity.

ABOUT CLAIM ASSIST SOLUTIONS:

Over 20 Years of Distinguished Excellence in Claims Solutions

Claim Assist Solutions provides exceptional service to the insurance industry and operates a family of brands that provide people, process, and technology to leading insurance carriers in the personal lines of auto and property, flood, and complex and commercial claims.

More Than a Provider, We Are a Trusted Partner

We build on our trusted reputation as a leading provider of outsourced claim services by delivering a full suite of end-to-end solutions that address all aspects of insurance resolution process

Every line of business. Every carrier. Every claim.

Capacity. Accuracy. Service.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Paralegal - Contracts & Litigation

Key Responsibilities — Contracts

  • Maintain and organize the contract repository, tracking key dates, renewal terms, and obligations.
  • Conduct due diligence reviews and flag risk provisions, non-standard terms, or compliance concerns for attorney review.
  • Support development and maintenance of contract templates.

Key Responsibilities — Litigation

  • Provide full-cycle litigation support, including intake, and deadline calendaring.
  • Manage discovery processes: document collection, review, privilege logs, and production using e-discovery platforms.
  • Draft and format pleadings, motions, discovery requests/responses, and correspondence under attorney supervision.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on case logistics and filings.
  • Conduct legal and factual research, and review case files as needed.
  • Ensure timely e-filing and compliance with local court rules and procedures.

Cross-Functional & General Duties

  • Prioritize and manage a mixed caseload of contract and litigation matters simultaneously, escalating conflicts or bottlenecks proactively.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive legal, business, and client information.
  • Support special projects, audits, and process improvement initiatives within the Legal Department.
  • Assist with budget tracking and invoice review for outside counsel engagements.

Qualifications

  • Paralegal Certificate from an ABA-approved program preferred.
  • Minimum 4–6 years of paralegal experience, with demonstrated experience in both contracts/transactional work and litigation support.
  • Working knowledge of civil procedures, e-discovery tools (e.g., DocuSign).
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and Adobe Acrobat; comfortable learning new legal technology platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced legal environment.
  • Notary Public certification a plus.

Claim Assist Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
